_comment: DV-108 is attached to DV-105 and asks two things: why you believe the children are at risk of being taken (item 3), and which orders you want the judge to make about it (items 4-10). Every field on it is the filer's - the form carries no court section, and says so on both pages. The form prints item 3 and items 4-10 as 'check all that apply' lists, so each is one multiSelect group here rather than a run of yes/no questions; the follow-up boxes hang off the option that asks for them.

groups.question: Why do you believe the person you want protection from might take your children? Check everything that is true.
labels: They have violated or threatened to violate a custody or visitation order
They do not have strong ties to California
They have done things recently that would make it easy to take the children
They have a history of abuse or of keeping the children from me
They have a criminal record
They have strong ties somewhere else
They are a citizen of another country

groups.question: What have they done recently that would make it easier to take the children?
labels: Quit a job
Applied for a passport, birth certificate, or school or medical records
Closed a bank account
Hidden or destroyed documents
Sold or gotten rid of property
Sold a home or ended a lease
Something else

groups.question: What do they have a history of?
labels: Abusing me
Taking away or hiding our children from me
Child abuse
Threatening to take away or hide our children from me
Abusing other partners
Not cooperating with me in parenting

groups.question: Where do they have strong ties?
labels: Another county in California
Another state
Another country

groups.question: Do they have strong family, cultural, or emotional ties to that country?
labels: Yes
No

groups.question: Which orders do you want the judge to make to prevent an abduction?
labels: Do not move with the children without my permission or the judge's
Turn in passports and other travel documents, and do not apply for more
Give me a travel plan and documents before travelling with the children
Register this order in another state before the children travel there
Notify a foreign embassy or consulate of the passport restrictions
Get a foreign custody and visitation order before the children travel
Post a bond

groups.question: What should they have to give you before they travel with the children?
labels: The children's travel schedule
Copies of round-trip airline tickets
Addresses and telephone numbers where the children can be reached
An open airline ticket for me, in case the children are not returned
Something else
